opening.argument: The presentation ties paid participation directly to a purported mining process: “when you purchase the packages you get tokens that you turn into mine the mining process.” It then promotes OneCoin through rapid-growth and aspirational claims, citing “187 newly created millionaires” becoming “285 new millionaires” alongside more than 453,000 members. The appeal is explicitly urgent and opportunity-driven, warning viewers, “don't miss a chance with OneCoin,” before instructing them to “Set up your membership today!” Although the presentation mentions due diligence and purported audits, these features do not alter its overall function as an endorsement and solicitation for paid packages and membership.
